children: Victoria's Secret delivered solid quarterly results and once again raised its annual outlook. However, shares tumbled 11% on Thursday.  Jefferies analysts chalk up the reaction to high expectations. Shares were already trading above historical norms going into the quarterly readout, the analysts say, suggesting that investors had already priced in the bra retailer's meaningfully improved underlying business fundamentals. They add that Victoria's Secret's profit outlook for the current quarter also came in slightly below Wall Street estimates. "Against that backdrop, Q2 was good, but perhaps not enough to materially exceed elevated expectations," the analysts wrote. (connor.hart@wsj.com)
